notes: The clothing catalogue (Queue 5 / Unit Y, design in docs/GDD-09-CHARACTER-CREATOR.md). Prices are NOT duplicated here: every entry points at data/prices.json `clothing` via price_ref (prices.json v1.2 owns the numbers; if the two ever disagree, prices.json wins and this file is fixed). An outfit is a list of item ids, one per slot (PHASE2-METAHUMAN-SHEET §5: outfits are data, not code). full_body and outfit_set/uniform_set items occupy their covered slots alone. Original NEXORA garments only — no real-brand logos, ever (PHASE2 §5).

profession_uniforms.notes: Worn in the Work sub-state (GDD-06 §4.1). Issued at hiring; replacement charged at catalogue price per GDD-09 §5.

Site context only (GDD-06 §4.2 morning). The afternoon office context is a dress code, not a uniform: own formal clothing (shirt_formal, trousers_formal, shoes_leather). The owner's character wears this set first (PHASE2 §5).

No issued uniform. School dress code is the formal context in the teacher's own clothes. Students wear uniform_school, bought by their household (GDD-09 §5) — the student mapping belongs to the education design (Unit AB).
Worn on duty and patrol (GDD-06 §4.5); the OffDuty interrupt wears own clothes.
Applies from progression tier 2 (depot car). Tier-1 rented-CNG drivers wear their own clothes (professions.json progression).
No uniform; d1_uptown office work is own casual/formal clothing (GDD-06 §4.8).
Own clothes behind their own counter (GDD-06 §4.9).
Own formal clothing; suit_set is the senior-tier status marker (GDD-06 §4.10).

Honest gap, stated not papered over: no airline operates from District 1 and there is no airport (GDD-06 §4.11), so nothing in District 1 issues this uniform today. It is catalogued for the future airport district; in District 1 the pilot wears own formal clothes on rest days.

source_doc: docs/GDD-09-CHARACTER-CREATOR.md (Unit Y). Outfit rules: docs/PHASE2-METAHUMAN-SHEET.md §5. Prices: data/prices.json `clothing` (v1.2). Profession ids: data/professions.json.

starting_outfits.notes: PROPOSED (Unit DD, Queue 16, authored — no source names a default starting outfit: GDD-09 §3 leaves the player character's three outfits to the creator's choice and Scheduled NPC outfits to randomised assembly from the catalogue). These lists are the sim genesis builder's deterministic default: one item per slot, every item's contexts include the outfit's context, every item resolves to the catalogue and to prices.json clothing. The UE creator (Phase 2) replaces them with the player's own picks; the sim keeps them so a genesis character holds real rows the losing events can name.
